name: Okton
role: smith of Steamside, founder of the Order of the Banked Fire
age: ancient, even for a fire giant
appearance: Eighteen feet of skin like cooled iron; a beard of dull red wire bound in brass rings; a hammer-scarred apron the size of a sail.
voice: Deep, slow, careful Common (Giant by preference); counts time in heats; calls Chadickith Small Tusk.
backstory: For about eighty years Okton has kept a vent-forge in Steamside, armouring Kharun's guard under the Velun kings and Ivoard Hask alike. In 1423 he drove the Gallowsbird off Hadrun and took in the orphaned loxodon boy Chadickith, whom he has raised for 68 years. He forged the Crown of Ash in 1453 and caught the burn from its coal; from that wound he built the Quenching and the Order of the Banked Fire. He killed the Gallowsbird at the Great Pyre, quenched Chadickith as he died, and now keeps a trial burn ward in his cellar.
wants: To deal with the Heartcoal one day, and to raise an Order strong enough to survive doing it.
fears: Becoming what the roc was, in front of the boy he raised.
secrets: He forged the Crown of Ash and set the Heartcoal himself in 1453 (Chadickith knows).
As a young warrior he marched in the host of the Bhaalspawn Yaga-Shura and deserted before the end; the Heartcoal is his old warlord's heart.
The Heartcoal lies sealed in the Dunmarrow vault.
He fought the Gallowsbird as a plain giant because his Blood Rites stir the burn in him.
dm_only: Stat block: fire giant plus Blood Hunter 18 (Order of the Pale Moon), player-approved; full kit in the lore entry's DM secrets.
Quenching costs and odds are in the locked rules block; never put numbers in his mouth.

traits.name: Feats
traits.text: Tough, Sentinel, Great Weapon Master, Alert (+5 initiative, can't be surprised).

traits.name: Great Weapon Fighting
traits.text: When he rolls a 1 or 2 on a greatsword damage die, he can reroll it.

traits.name: Blood Hunter (Alternate, laserllama v2.2)
traits.text: Rite Die d10, rite save DC 20. Rites: Binding, Agony, Dread, Exposure, Marking, Blindness. Hardened Soul, Dark Augmentation, Crimson Offering, Crimson Brand and Anchor, Grim Psychometry. He keeps the kit sealed: using it stirs the burn.

traits.name: Order of the Pale Moon
traits.text: Feral Senses; Lycanthropic Curse (progenitor exception: Roc form); Hybrid Form; Lycan Warrior; Feral Prowess; Lycanthropic Mastery.
